_comment: Curated Ollama release that installed Artha apps install/update to THROUGH Artha (packages/app/src/llm/ollamaRuntimeManager.ts). Binaries are fetched from the official GitHub release for this exact tag and SHA-256-verified against its sha256sum.txt. Only bump after running Artha against the new version; apps never move BELOW their bundled pin (BUNDLED_PIN_VERSION), so this can only roll users forward.
